verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a tax and licensing agency, but nothing in the pack shows a public status lookup for a filing, application, or case. The pack has only adjacent material: published processing-time estimates (10 business days online, up to six weeks by mail) and a generic 'Look up a business' link that is not documented as showing application or filing status. Transactional activity sits behind the authenticated My DOR login wall, which is not a public page.
